BiblicalUsage: A fourth part of a hin of wine went with the lamb of the daily offering. The living creatures had four sides, and the servant of Saul had the fourth part of a shekel of silver to give the man of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that God counts the fractions too, and the fourth part is measured as carefully as the whole.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
